AXEBOTS_NORMAL.name: Axebots
rules: The Axebots spawned mid-fight via Stock opens with Boot Up before entering the cycle. The second spawned Axebot uses the improved version of Boot Up. Every time a new Axebot is spawned it gains +10 Max HP more than the last one (So the first respawn has 10 HP more, the second 20 HP more etc.).
Stock provides successive opportunities to activate Fatal triggers with Hand of Greed.

If a multi-hit Attack that doesn't target a single enemy (such as Sword Boomerang or Dagger Spray) kills an Axebot with Stock partway through the attack, the new Axebot will be summoned in the middle of the attack, and it can be hit by that same Attack.

If an Attack that hits all enemies and applies a debuff (such as Thunderclap or High Five) kills an Axebot with Stock, the new Axebot will be summoned in the middle of the attack, before the debuff is applied. The new Axebot will then be inflicted with the debuff.
When an Axebot with Stock dies during the enemy turn, such as by Poison or Thorns, the summoned Axebot will not do anything that turn, and it will use Boot Up on the following turn.
Stock respawns gain +10 Max HP cumulatively each time.

DECIMILLIPEDE_ELITE.name: Decimillipede
rules: Each segment starts on a different move, which will remain the case until one or more of them is killed.

When a segment is killed, it uses Reattach to revive with 25 HP provided at least one other segment is still alive. After reviving, it resumes with a random move. which may disrupt their prior synchrony.

Because Doom triggers after Decimillipede segments will have regenerated via Reattach, it can sometimes lead to scenarios wherein one or more segments are actively dying via Doom, but not until after the other(s) have respawned. Which can reoccur the following turn, depending on the player's Doom sources.
This fight is functionally similar to the Darklings from Slay the Spire 1, with the same dynamic of 3 enemies that will revive if any of the others are alive.
Reducing the HP of one of them to 0 does not count as a Fatal kill unless it was the final enemy.

rules: When Phrog Parasite dies, Infested triggers and 4 Wrigglers are summoned. They will be Stunned and do nothing on their first turn. The fight continues until all Wrigglers are defeated.
Whether the Wrigglers are Stunned on the player's next turn depends on if the Phrog Parasite dies during the player turn or the enemy turn:
If the Phrog Parasite is killed with an Attack card or damage from an Orb, the Wrigglers will be Stunned during this turn, not the player's next turn.
If the Phrog Parasite dies to Poison or Doom, then the Wrigglers will have no Intent when spawned. They will be Stunned during the player's next turn.
